mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, restrictive monetary policy reduces corporate borrowing capacity, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for two months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate and payroll employment signal labor market overheating, triggering inflationary pressures that depress S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE and PAYEMS both decline in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months where both UNRATE and PAYEMS decline.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, residential sales above 750,000 million dollars signal consumer credit overextension, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS > 750000 during late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 for two consecutive months indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings growth and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1,400,000 units signal strong consumer spending momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when HOUST > 1400.0.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 3.5%), payroll employment above 158,000 thousand persons signals labor market tightness that accelerates inflation, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS > 158000 and UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 95 for two consecutive months indicates manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate earnings growth and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when INDPRO < 95 for two consecutive months.
